other_conditions: Must be an institutional student in a recognized school in Uttarakhand
Must have passed the previous year's examination
Cannot be studying in more than one school in the same academic year
Name on the scholarship application must match the name on Aadhaar and bank account
Must provide the guardian's mobile number
The same mobile number can be used by multiple students from the same family
benefits_summary: Students in classes 1‑5 receive ₹600 per year, and students in classes 6‑8 receive ₹960 per year.
